ts
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { mountWorkspaceRegister } from '../templates/account/register/mount.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const result = await mountWorkspaceRegister(
		element,
		{ i18n, inheritAppearance: true },
		onError
	);
	return result;
}

import { computed, reactive, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n, AsamI18nCall } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createAsamMessageIssue, formatFieldIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { accountMessageDefaults } from './I18n.js';
import { safeReturnPath, scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type {
	AccountHost,
	AccountProfile,
	AccountRequest,
	AccountSettings,
	Registration,
	RegistrationField,
	SettingsField,
	Verification,
	WriteResult
} from './Types.js';

const emptySettings = (): AccountSettings => ({
	displayName: '',
	email: '',
	phone: '',
	language: 'zh-CN',
	notifications: false,
	digest: false
});
const text = (value: unknown) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value : '');
export function safeProfile(value: AccountProfile): AccountProfile {
	return {
		displayName: text(value.displayName),
		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		organization: text(value.organization),
		role: text(value.role),
		joined: text(value.joined),
		avatar: safeAccountUrl(value.avatar),
		website: safeAccountUrl(value.website)
	};
}
/** No data/blob/protocol-relative URLs. Host should restrict remote hosts further. */
export function safeAccountUrl(value: unknown): string | undefined {
	// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- Reject URL control characters, as before.
	if (typeof value !== 'string' || /[\\\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/.test(value)) return;
	if (value.startsWith('/') && !value.startsWith('//') && !/%[0-9a-f]{2}/i.test(value))
		return value;
	try {
		const url = new URL(value);
		return url.protocol === 'https:' && !url.username && !url.password ? url.href : undefined;
	} catch {
		return;
	}
}
function copySettings(value: AccountSettings): AccountSettings {
	return {
		displayName: text(value.displayName),
		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		language: text(value.language),
		notifications: value.notifications === true,
		digest: value.digest === true,
		...(typeof value.biography === 'string' ? { biography: value.biography } : {}),
		...(typeof value.officeArea === 'string' ? { officeArea: value.officeArea } : {})
	};
}
type MessageIssue = ReturnType<typeof createAsamMessageIssue>;
function feedback<Field extends string>(owner?: AsamI18n) {
	const scope = owner ? extendAsamI18n(owner, accountMessageDefaults) : undefined;
	const message = ref('');
	const source = shallowRef<MessageIssue>();
	const sources = shallowRef<Partial<Record<Field, MessageIssue>>>({});
	const errors = ref<Partial<Record<Field, string>>>({});
	function setMessage(legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall | []) {
		message.value = legacy;
		source.value = call.length ? createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call) : undefined;
	}
	return {
		message,
		errors,
		sources,
		setMessage,
		displayMessage: computed(() =>
			scope && source.value ? formatFieldIssue(source.value, scope) : message.value
		),
		displayErrors: computed(
			() =>
				Object.fromEntries(
					Object.entries(errors.value).map(([key, value]) => [
						key,
						scope && sources.value[key as Field]
							? formatFieldIssue(sources.value[key as Field]!, scope)
							: value
					])
				) as Partial<Record<Field, string>>
		),
		dispose: () => scope?.dispose()
	};
}
export function registrationIssues(
	host: AccountHost,
	value: Registration & { confirm: string },
	sources: Partial<Record<RegistrationField, MessageIssue>> = {}
) {
	const errors: Partial<Record<RegistrationField, string>> = {};
	function add(field: RegistrationField, legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall) {
		errors[field] = legacy;
		sources[field] = createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call);
	}
	if (!/^[\p{L}\p{N}_.-]{3,40}$/u.test(value.account))
		add(
			'account',
			'用户名需为3至40个字母、数字或 _ . -',
			'app.templates.account.accountInvalid'
		);
	if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.email))
		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');
	if (value.password.length < (host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8))
		add(
			'password',
			`密码至少${host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8}位`,
			'app.templates.account.passwordShort',
			{ minimum: host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8 }
		);
	if (value.password !== value.confirm)
		add('confirm', '两次输入的密码不一致', 'app.templates.account.passwordMismatch');
	if (host.registration?.requireConsent !== false && !value.consent)
		add('consent', '请先同意账户使用条款', 'app.templates.account.consentRequired');
	const hostErrors = host.registration?.validate?.(value);
	for (const key of Object.keys(hostErrors ?? {})) delete sources[key as RegistrationField];
	return { ...errors, ...hostErrors };
}
export function settingsIssues(
	value: AccountSettings,
	host: AccountHost,
	sources: Partial<Record<SettingsField, MessageIssue>> = {}
) {
	const errors: Partial<Record<SettingsField, string>> = {};
	function add(field: SettingsField, legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall) {
		errors[field] = legacy;
		sources[field] = createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call);
	}
	if (!value.displayName.trim() || value.displayName.length > 60)
		add('displayName', '显示名需为1至60个字符', 'app.templates.account.nameInvalid');
	if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.email))
		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');
	if (value.phone && !/^[+\d ()-]{5,30}$/.test(value.phone))
		add('phone', '请填写有效联系电话或留空', 'app.templates.account.phoneInvalid');
	if (
		!(host.languages ?? [{ value: 'zh-CN' }, { value: 'en' }]).some(
			(i) => i.value === value.language
		)
	)
		add('language', '请选择支持的语言', 'app.templates.account.languageInvalid');
	return errors;
}

/** Page-owned requests only. Security/transport state machines remain in 033/035. */
function owner(host: AccountHost, invalidate: () => void) {
	let version = 0;
	let disposed = false;
	const requests = new Set<AbortController>();
	function clear() {
		++version;
		const prior = [...requests];
		requests.clear();
		invalidate();
		for (const request of prior) request.abort();
	}
	const remove = host.security.onInvalidate(clear);
	const stop = watch(
		() => {
			const state = host.security.state.value;
			return JSON.stringify([
				state.epoch,
				state.status,
				state.subject && scopeKey(state.subject)
			]);
		},
		clear,
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	return {
		clear,
		request(operationId: string, protectedRead = false): AccountRequest & { release(): void } {
			const controller = new AbortController();
			requests.add(controller);
			const revision = version;
			const state = host.security.state.value;
			const identity = state.subject && scopeKey(state.subject);
			return {
				operationId,
				signal: controller.signal,
				isCurrent: () =>
					!disposed &&
					!controller.signal.aborted &&
					revision === version &&
					(!protectedRead ||
						(host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticated' &&
							!!host.security.state.value.subject &&
							host.security.state.value.epoch === state.epoch &&
							scopeKey(host.security.state.value.subject) === identity)),
				release: () => requests.delete(controller)
			};
		},
		dispose() {
			disposed = true;
			stop();
			remove();
			clear();
		}
	};
}

/** 可选设置面板复用同一页面请求归属，不另建安全或写入状态机。 */
export { owner as createAccountRequestScope };

export function createRegistration(host: AccountHost, i18n?: AsamI18n) {
	const display = feedback<RegistrationField>(i18n);
	const { errors, message, sources, setMessage } = display;
	const draft = reactive<Registration & { confirm: string }>({
		account: '',
		email: '',
		password: '',
		confirm: '',
		consent: false
	});
	const status = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown'>(
		'idle'
	);
	const operationId = ref('');
	const secretClear = () => {
		draft.password = '';
		draft.confirm = '';
	};
	const session = owner(host, () => {
		Object.assign(draft, { account: '', email: '', password: '', confirm: '', consent: false });
		status.value = 'idle';
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		operationId.value = '';
	});
	function accept(result: WriteResult<RegistrationField>) {
		status.value = result.status;
		errors.value = result.status === 'field-error' ? result.fields : {};
		sources.value = {};
		if (result.status === 'success' || result.status === 'failure') setMessage(result.message);
		else if (result.status === 'unknown')
			setMessage('提交结果待核实，请勿重复注册', 'app.templates.account.registrationUnknown');
		else
			setMessage(
				'请检查标出的字段后重新填写密码',
				'app.templates.account.registrationFields'
			);
	}
	async function submit(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || ['pending', 'unknown', 'success'].includes(status.value)) return false;
		try {
			sources.value = {};
			errors.value = registrationIssues(host, draft, sources.value);
		} catch {
			setMessage('字段校验未能完成', 'app.templates.account.validationFailed');
			return false;
		}
		if (Object.values(errors.value).some(Boolean)) {
			status.value = 'field-error';
			return false;
		}
		const input: Registration = {
			account: draft.account,
			email: draft.email,
			password: draft.password,
			consent: draft.consent
		};
		operationId.value = host.operationId();
		const request = session.request(operationId.value);
		status.value = 'pending';
		setMessage('');
		secretClear();
		try {
			const result = await host.services.register(input, request);
			if (!request.isCurrent()) return false;
			accept(result);
			return result.status === 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			input.password = '';
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function verify(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || status.value !== 'unknown' || !host.services.verifyRegistration)
			return false;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value);
		status.value = 'pending';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.verifyRegistration(operationId.value, request);
			if (request.isCurrent()) {
				if (result.status === 'not-written') {
					status.value = 'idle';
					setMessage(
						'已核实未写入，可重新填写密码后提交',
						'app.templates.account.registrationNotWritten'
					);
				} else accept(result);
				return result.status === 'success';
			}
			return false;
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	return {
		draft,
		status,
		errors,
		message,
		displayMessage: display.displayMessage,
		displayErrors: display.displayErrors,
		operationId,
		submit,
		verify,
		secretClear,
		clear: session.clear,
		dispose() {
			session.dispose();
			display.dispose();
		}
	};
}

type AccountNotificationField = 'notifications' | 'digest';
type LocalNotificationField = 'projectUpdates' | 'systemNotices';
export type NotificationChange = {
	field: AccountNotificationField | LocalNotificationField;
	value: boolean;
};

/** Optional page-local draft companion; never adds keys to AccountSettings or its payload. */
export interface AccountSettingsCompanion {
	dirty(): boolean;
	loaded(operationId: string): void;
	capture(operationId: string, notification?: NotificationChange): void;
	accept(operationId: string): void;
	rollbackNotification?(operationId: string): void;
	revert(): void;
	clear(): void;
}
export function createAccountData(
	host: AccountHost,
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	companion?: AccountSettingsCompanion
) {
	const display = feedback<SettingsField>(i18n);
	const { errors, message, sources, setMessage } = display;
	const profile = ref<AccountProfile | null>(null);
	const profileStatus = ref<'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'empty' | 'error'>('idle');
	const draft = reactive(emptySettings());
	function replaceDraft(value: AccountSettings) {
		delete draft.biography;
		delete draft.officeArea;
		Object.assign(draft, value);
	}
	const original = ref(emptySettings());
	const settingsStatus = ref<'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'>('idle');
	const saveStatus = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown'>(
		'idle'
	);
	const displayStatus = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
	const operationId = ref('');
	let savedPayload: AccountSettings | undefined;
	let savedNotification: NotificationChange | undefined;
	const session = owner(host, () => {
		profile.value = null;
		profileStatus.value = 'idle';
		replaceDraft(emptySettings());
		original.value = emptySettings();
		settingsStatus.value = 'idle';
		saveStatus.value = 'idle';
		displayStatus.value = 'idle';
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		operationId.value = '';
		savedPayload = undefined;
		savedNotification = undefined;
		companion?.clear();
	});
	const dirty = computed(
		() => JSON.stringify(draft) !== JSON.stringify(original.value) || !!companion?.dirty()
	);
	const subject = () =>
		host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticated'
			? host.security.state.value.subject
			: null;
	const allowed = (write = false) =>
		host.security.check({ permission: write ? 'account:write' : 'account:read', write }) ===
		'allowed';
	let profileRevision = 0,
		settingsRevision = 0;
	async function loadProfile(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (blocked || !person || !allowed()) return;
		const revision = ++profileRevision;
		const request = session.request(host.operationId(), true);
		profile.value = null;
		profileStatus.value = 'loading';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.profile(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === profileRevision && allowed()) {
				profile.value = result && safeProfile(result);
				profileStatus.value = result ? 'ready' : 'empty';
			}
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === profileRevision) profileStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function loadSettings(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value === 'pending' ||
			saveStatus.value === 'unknown' ||
			dirty.value
		)
			return;
		const revision = ++settingsRevision;
		const request = session.request(host.operationId(), true);
		settingsStatus.value = 'loading';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.settings(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === settingsRevision && allowed()) {
				original.value = copySettings(result);
				replaceDraft(original.value);
				companion?.loaded(request.operationId);
				settingsStatus.value = 'ready';
			}
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === settingsRevision)
				settingsStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	function revert(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(saveStatus.value)) return;
		replaceDraft(original.value);
		companion?.revert();
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		saveStatus.value = 'idle';
	}
	function accept(result: WriteResult<SettingsField>) {
		saveStatus.value = result.status;
		errors.value = result.status === 'field-error' ? result.fields : {};
		sources.value = {};
		if (result.status === 'success' && savedNotification)
			setMessage('通知偏好已保存', 'app.templates.account.notificationSaved');
		else if (result.status === 'success' || result.status === 'failure')
			setMessage(result.message);
		else if (result.status === 'unknown')
			setMessage('保存结果待核实，请勿再次保存', 'app.templates.account.saveUnknown');
		else setMessage('请检查标出的字段', 'app.templates.account.saveFields');
		if (result.status === 'success' && savedPayload) {
			original.value = copySettings(savedPayload);
			if (!savedNotification) replaceDraft(original.value);
			companion?.accept(operationId.value);
		} else if (result.status !== 'unknown') rollbackNotification();
	}
	function rollbackNotification() {
		const field = savedNotification?.field;
		if (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest') draft[field] = original.value[field];
		if (field) companion?.rollbackNotification?.(operationId.value);
	}
	async function save(blocked = false, notification?: NotificationChange) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed(true) ||
			settingsStatus.value !== 'ready' ||
			(!notification && !dirty.value) ||
			['pending', 'unknown'].includes(saveStatus.value)
		)
			return false;
		const payload = notification ? copySettings(original.value) : copySettings(draft);
		const field = notification?.field;
		if (notification && (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest')) {
			if (payload[field] === notification.value) return false;
			payload[field] = notification.value;
		} else if (notification && !companion) return false;
		sources.value = {};
		errors.value = settingsIssues(notification ? payload : draft, host, sources.value);
		if (Object.values(errors.value).some(Boolean)) {
			saveStatus.value = 'field-error';
			if (notification) setMessage('请检查标出的字段', 'app.templates.account.saveFields');
			return false;
		}
		operationId.value = host.operationId();
		savedPayload = payload;
		savedNotification = notification;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		saveStatus.value = 'pending';
		setMessage('');
		displayStatus.value = 'idle';
		try {
			if (!request.isCurrent() || !allowed(true)) return false;
			companion?.capture(operationId.value, notification);
			if (notification && (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest'))
				draft[field] = notification.value;
			const result = await host.services.save(person, savedPayload, request);
			if (!request.isCurrent() || !allowed()) return false;
			accept(result);
			return result.status === 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function verify(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value !== 'unknown' ||
			!host.services.verifySave
		)
			return false;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		saveStatus.value = 'pending';
		try {
			const result: Verification<SettingsField> = await host.services.verifySave(
				person,
				operationId.value,
				request
			);
			if (request.isCurrent() && allowed()) {
				if (result.status === 'not-written') {
					rollbackNotification();
					saveStatus.value = 'idle';
					setMessage('已核实未写入，可重新保存', 'app.templates.account.saveNotWritten');
				} else accept(result);
				return result.status === 'success';
			}
			return false;
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function refreshDisplay(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value !== 'success' ||
			displayStatus.value === 'pending' ||
			!host.services.refreshDisplay
		)
			return;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		displayStatus.value = 'pending';
		try {
			await host.services.refreshDisplay(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent()) displayStatus.value = 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) displayStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	return {
		profile,
		profileStatus,
		draft,
		original,
		dirty,
		settingsStatus,
		saveStatus,
		displayStatus,
		errors,
		message,
		displayMessage: display.displayMessage,
		displayErrors: display.displayErrors,
		operationId,
		allowed,
		loadProfile,
		loadSettings,
		revert,
		save,
		verify,
		refreshDisplay,
		clear: session.clear,
		dispose() {
			session.dispose();
			display.dispose();
		}
	};
}

export function loginDestination(host: AccountHost, value: unknown) {
	const path = safeReturnPath(value, '/account/profile');
	return host.canNavigate(path) ? path : undefined;
}

import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
type SecurityController = ReturnType<typeof createSecurity>;
import type { SecurityRequest, SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';

export type AccountFamily = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech';
export type AccountPage = 'login' | 'register' | 'profile' | 'settings';
export interface LoginCredentials {
	account: string;
	password: string;
}
export interface Registration extends LoginCredentials {
	email: string;
	consent: boolean;
}
export interface AccountSettings {
	displayName: string;
	email: string;
	phone: string;
	language: string;
	notifications: boolean;
	digest: boolean;
	/** 可选前端资料扩展；未接入的宿主继续只返回原六字段。 */
	biography?: string;
	officeArea?: string;
}
/** Display allowlist. Map backend DTOs at the host boundary. */
export interface AccountProfile {
	displayName: string;
	email: string;
	phone: string;
	organization: string;
	role: string;
	joined: string;
	avatar?: string;
	website?: string;
}
export type RegistrationField = 'account' | 'email' | 'password' | 'confirm' | 'consent';
export type SettingsField = keyof AccountSettings;
/** Messages are display-safe host text, never raw server exceptions/DTOs. */
export type WriteResult<K extends string> =
	| { status: 'success'; message: string }
	| { status: 'field-error'; fields: Partial<Record<K, string>> }
	| { status: 'failure'; message: string }
	| { status: 'unknown' };
export type Verification<K extends string> = WriteResult<K> | { status: 'not-written' };
export interface AccountRequest extends SecurityRequest {
	readonly operationId: string;
}
export interface AccountServices {
	/** Host must gate authentication/storage side effects with BOTH requests' isCurrent. */
	login(credentials: Readonly<LoginCredentials>, request: AccountRequest): Promise<boolean>;
	register(
		input: Readonly<Registration>,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<WriteResult<RegistrationField>>;
	profile(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<AccountProfile | null>;
	settings(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<AccountSettings>;
	save(
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		settings: Readonly<AccountSettings>,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<WriteResult<SettingsField>>;
	verifyRegistration?(
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<Verification<RegistrationField>>;
	verifySave?(
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<Verification<SettingsField>>;
	/** Refresh the host's display projection only. Must not save again or mutate page drafts. */
	refreshDisplay?(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<void>;
}
export interface AccountHost {
	security: Pick<SecurityController, 'state' | 'check' | 'onInvalidate'>;
	services: AccountServices;
	/** Stable id for one mutation. Generate once, preserve through unknown/verification. */
	operationId(): string;
	/** Explicit host allowlist. safeReturnPath is always applied first. */
	canNavigate(path: string): boolean;
	navigate(path: string): void | Promise<void>;
	/** An escalation action, never an implicit retry. Receives no secrets or payload. */
	resolveUnknown(kind: 'register' | 'save', operationId: string): void;
	registration?: {
		accountLabel?: string;
		minimumPasswordLength?: number;
		requireConsent?: boolean;
		validate?(
			input: Readonly<Registration & { confirm: string }>
		): Partial<Record<RegistrationField, string>>;
	};
	languages?: readonly { value: string; label: string }[];
}
export interface AccountPageProps {
	host: AccountHost;
	brand?: string;
	accountLabel?: string;
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
	returnPath?: unknown;
}
export interface AccountPageEvents {
	page: [page: AccountPage];
	/** Register/save emit once per operation, on direct or verified success in the current page. */
	completed: [kind: 'login' | 'register' | 'save'];
}
export interface AccountPageExpose {
	clear(): void;
}

import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createRequestClient, TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { createLatestRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type {
	AccountHost,
	AccountProfile,
	AccountRequest,
	AccountSettings,
	LoginCredentials,
	RegistrationField,
	SettingsField,
	WriteResult
} from '../Types.js';
import type { SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';

export const exampleBrand = 'ASAM';
export const exampleAccountLabel = '账户';
export type FixtureMode = 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown' | 'empty' | 'late';
/** Synthetic local adapter. No fetch, URL, cookie, token, storage or real account. */
export function createAccountFixture(
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	profileFields?: Pick<AccountSettings, 'biography' | 'officeArea'>
) {
	const controls = reactive({
		mode: 'success' as FixtureMode,
		delay: 0,
		refreshFailure: false,
		readOnly: false
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		login: 0,
		lastAccount: '',
		register: 0,
		save: 0,
		profile: 0,
		settings: 0,
		verify: 0,
		refresh: 0,
		disposed: false,
		navigations: [] as string[],
		escalations: [] as string[]
	});
	let sequence = 0;
	let currentId: string | number = 0;
	let profileName = '林予安';
	let settings: AccountSettings = {
		displayName: '林予安',
		email: 'lin@example.invalid',
		phone: '+86 010 5555 0186',
		language: 'zh-CN',
		notifications: true,
		digest: false,
		...(typeof profileFields?.biography === 'string'
			? { biography: profileFields.biography }
			: {}),
		...(typeof profileFields?.officeArea === 'string'
			? { officeArea: profileFields.officeArea }
			: {})
	};
	const operations = new Map<string, WriteResult<SettingsField | RegistrationField>>();
	const wait = () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, controls.delay));
	const subject = (): SecuritySubject => ({
		id: currentId,
		name: profileName,
		roles: ['member'],
		permissions: ['account:read', 'account:write'],
		scope: { tenant: 0, organization: 0 },
		contexts: [
			{ tenant: 0, organization: 0, label: '演示团队' },
			{ tenant: '0', organization: '0', label: '演示团队 B' }
		],
		expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600000,
		readOnly: controls.readOnly
	});
	const security = createSecurity<LoginCredentials & { caller: AccountRequest }>({
		i18n,
		adapter: {
			async login(credentials, request) {
				audit.login++;
				audit.lastAccount = credentials.account;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent() || !credentials.caller.isCurrent())
					throw new Error('Cancelled');
				if (controls.mode === 'failure') throw new Error('Synthetic failure');
				return subject();
			},
			async restore(request) {
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent() ? subject() : null;
			},
			async refresh(_subject, request) {
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return subject();
			},
			async switchContext(person, scope, request) {
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return { ...person, scope };
			},
			async logout() {
				await wait();
			}
		}
	});
	const client = createRequestClient({
		i18n,
		transport: async (input) => {
			const mode = controls.mode;
			const delay = controls.delay;
			await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
			if (mode === 'failure') throw new TransportFault('network');
			if (input.url === 'fixture:profile') {
				audit.profile++;
				const person = input.data as SecuritySubject;
				return {
					mode: 'data',
					data:
						mode === 'empty'
							? null
							: {
									displayName: person.id === 0 ? profileName : '顾行舟',
									email: settings.email,
									phone: settings.phone,
									organization: `演示组织 ${String(person.scope.organization)}`,
									role: '应用成员',
									joined: '2026-10-01',
									secret: 'must-not-render'
								}
				};
			}
			if (input.url === 'fixture:settings') {
				audit.settings++;
				return { mode: 'data', data: { ...settings } };
			}
			throw new TransportFault('unknown');
		}
	});
	const host: AccountHost = {
		security,
		operationId: () => `synthetic-${++sequence}`,
		canNavigate: (path) => ['/account/profile', '/account/settings'].includes(path),
		navigate: (path) => {
			audit.navigations.push(path);
		},
		resolveUnknown: (kind, id) => {
			audit.escalations.push(`${kind}:${id}`);
		},
		services: {
			login: (credentials, caller) => security.login({ ...credentials, caller }),
			async register(input, request) {
				audit.register++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result: WriteResult<RegistrationField> =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '该邮箱已用于合成账户' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示注册失败，可修改后重试' }
							: { status: 'success', message: `账户 ${input.account} 已创建` };
				operations.set(request.operationId, result);
				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;
			},
			async profile(person, request) {
				// Each page read owns a Latest wrapper, never a shared mutable global request slot.
				const latest = createLatestRequest<AccountProfile | null>(client, () => undefined);
				try {
					return await latest.load(
						{ url: 'fixture:profile', data: person },
						{
							signal: request.signal,
							decode: (value) => value as AccountProfile | null
						}
					);
				} finally {
					latest.dispose();
				}
			},
			settings: (_person, request) =>
				client.request(
					{ url: 'fixture:settings' },
					{ signal: request.signal, decode: (value) => value as AccountSettings }
				),
			async save(_person, input, request) {
				audit.save++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result: WriteResult<SettingsField> =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '此邮箱未通过应用规则' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示保存被拒绝，请修改后重试' }
							: { status: 'success', message: '账户设置已保存' };
				if (result.status === 'success') settings = { ...input };
				operations.set(request.operationId, result);
				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;
			},
			async verifyRegistration(id, request) {
				audit.verify++;
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent()
					? ((operations.get(id) as WriteResult<RegistrationField>) ?? {
							status: 'not-written'
						})
					: { status: 'unknown' };
			},
			async verifySave(_subject, id, request) {
				audit.verify++;
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent()
					? ((operations.get(id) as WriteResult<SettingsField>) ?? {
							status: 'not-written'
						})
					: { status: 'unknown' };
			},
			async refreshDisplay(_subject, request) {
				audit.refresh++;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent() || controls.refreshFailure)
					throw new Error('Synthetic display failure');
				profileName = settings.displayName;
			}
		}
	};
	return {
		host,
		controls,
		audit,
		security,
		client,
		async identity(id: string | number) {
			currentId = id;
			await security.restore();
		},
		dispose() {
			audit.disposed = true;
			security.dispose();
			client.dispose();
		}
	};
}

import { computed, onScopeDispose, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import type { AccountHost, AccountRequest } from '../Types.js';
import type { AccountPhoneLogin, PhoneSendResult, PhoneSendVerification } from './Types.js';

export function validLoginPhone(value: string) {
	return /^[+\d ()-]{5,30}$/.test(value) && value.replace(/\D/g, '').length >= 5;
}

/** 页面自己的发送与冷却状态；不实现短信传输或验证码校验服务。 */
export function createPhoneChallenge(
	options: () => {
		host: AccountHost;
		phone?: Pick<AccountPhoneLogin, 'owner' | 'send' | 'verifySend'>;
		disabled?: boolean;
		readonly?: boolean;
		startingAuthentication?: boolean;
	}
) {
	const status = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'verifying' | 'sent' | 'failure' | 'unknown'>('idle');
	const remaining = ref(0);
	const feedback = ref<'sendSent' | 'sendFailed' | 'sendUnknown' | 'sendNotSent'>();
	let disposed = false,
		revision = 0;
	let abort: AbortController | undefined;
	let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
	let deadline = 0;
	let record:
		| {
				phone: string;
				operationId: string;
				capability: Pick<AccountPhoneLogin, 'owner' | 'send' | 'verifySend'>;
		  }
		| undefined;
	const owned = computed(
		() => !!options().phone && options().phone?.owner === options().host.security
	);
	const busy = computed(() => status.value === 'pending' || status.value === 'verifying');
	const uncertain = computed(() => status.value === 'unknown' || status.value === 'verifying');
	function stopTimer() {
		if (timer !== undefined) clearInterval(timer);
		timer = undefined;
	}
	function clear() {
		++revision;
		abort?.abort();
		abort = undefined;
		stopTimer();
		record = undefined;
		status.value = 'idle';
		remaining.value = 0;
		feedback.value = undefined;
	}
	function cancel() {
		++revision;
		abort?.abort();
		abort = undefined;
		if (busy.value) {
			status.value = 'unknown';
			feedback.value = 'sendUnknown';
		}
	}
	function confirmSent(seconds: number) {
		if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0 || seconds > 86400) {
			status.value = 'unknown';
			feedback.value = 'sendUnknown';
			return;
		}
		stopTimer();
		deadline = Date.now() + Math.ceil(seconds) * 1000;
		const tick = () => {
			remaining.value = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((deadline - Date.now()) / 1000));
			if (!remaining.value) stopTimer();
		};
		tick();
		if (remaining.value) timer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
		status.value = 'sent';
		feedback.value = 'sendSent';
	}
	function request(readonly: boolean): AccountRequest {
		const current = ++revision,
			host = options().host;
		const controller = new AbortController();
		abort = controller;
		return {
			operationId: record!.operationId,
			signal: controller.signal,
			isCurrent: () =>
				!disposed &&
				current === revision &&
				!controller.signal.aborted &&
				host === options().host &&
				record?.capability.owner === host.security &&
				owned.value &&
				!options().disabled &&
				(readonly || !options().readonly)
		};
	}
	async function send(phone: string) {
		if (
			!owned.value ||
			options().disabled ||
			options().readonly ||
			busy.value ||
			uncertain.value ||
			remaining.value ||
			!validLoginPhone(phone)
		)
			return;
		record = { phone, operationId: options().host.operationId(), capability: options().phone! };
		const current = request(false);
		status.value = 'pending';
		feedback.value = undefined;
		try {
			const result: PhoneSendResult = await record.capability.send(phone, current);
			if (!current.isCurrent()) return;
			if (result.status === 'sent') confirmSent(result.retryAfterSeconds);
			else {
				status.value = result.status;
				feedback.value = result.status === 'failure' ? 'sendFailed' : 'sendUnknown';
			}
		} catch {
			if (current.isCurrent()) {
				status.value = 'unknown';
				feedback.value = 'sendUnknown';
			}
		}
	}
	async function verify() {
		if (
			!owned.value ||
			options().disabled ||
			status.value !== 'unknown' ||
			!record?.capability.verifySend
		)
			return;
		const current = request(true);
		status.value = 'verifying';
		try {
			const result: PhoneSendVerification = await record.capability.verifySend(
				record.operationId,
				current
			);
			if (!current.isCurrent()) return;
			if (result.status === 'sent') confirmSent(result.retryAfterSeconds);
			else if (result.status === 'not-sent') {
				status.value = 'idle';
				feedback.value = 'sendNotSent';
			} else {
				status.value = 'unknown';
				feedback.value = 'sendUnknown';
			}
		} catch {
			if (current.isCurrent()) {
				status.value = 'unknown';
				feedback.value = 'sendUnknown';
			}
		}
	}
	let remove = () => {};
	const stopHost = watch(
		() => options().host,
		(host) => {
			remove();
			clear();
			remove = host.security.onInvalidate(() => {
				if (!options().startingAuthentication) clear();
			});
		},
		{ immediate: true, flush: 'sync' }
	);
	const stopOwner = watch(
		() => options().phone?.owner,
		() => clear(),
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	const stopBlocked = watch(
		() => [options().disabled, options().readonly],
		() => {
			if (busy.value) cancel();
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	function dispose() {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		clear();
		remove();
		stopHost();
		stopOwner();
		stopBlocked();
	}
	onScopeDispose(dispose);
	return {
		status,
		remaining,
		feedback,
		owned,
		busy,
		uncertain,
		send,
		verify,
		cancel,
		clear,
		dispose,
		canAuthenticate: (phone: string) => status.value === 'sent' && record?.phone === phone,
		get operationId() {
			return record?.operationId;
		}
	};
}
ts
import type { AccountHost, AccountRequest } from '../Types.js';

export interface PhoneLoginCredentials {
	readonly phone: string;
	readonly code: string;
}
export type PhoneSendResult =
	| { readonly status: 'sent'; readonly retryAfterSeconds: number }
	| { readonly status: 'failure' }
	| { readonly status: 'unknown' };
export type PhoneSendVerification = PhoneSendResult | { readonly status: 'not-sent' };

/** 可选前端能力；owner必须是当前AccountHost的同一个security控制器。 */
export interface AccountPhoneLogin {
	readonly owner: AccountHost['security'];
	/** 宿主在真正发送前核验request.isCurrent；异常按未知发送处理。 */
	readonly send: (phone: string, request: AccountRequest) => Promise<PhoneSendResult>;
	/** 只核实原操作，不发送新验证码；只有not-sent允许显式重试。 */
	readonly verifySend?: (
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	) => Promise<PhoneSendVerification>;
	/** 独立手机登录协议，不把code映射为旧LoginCredentials.password。 */
	readonly authenticate: (
		credentials: Readonly<PhoneLoginCredentials>,
		request: AccountRequest
	) => Promise<boolean>;
}

import { onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import type { AccountHost, AccountRequest, RegistrationField, Verification } from '../Types.js';
import type { AccountPhoneRegistration } from './Types.js';
export interface RegisterAdapterOptions {
	mode: 'account' | 'phone';
	phone?: AccountPhoneRegistration;
	credentials(): { phone: string; code: string };
	revision?: string | number;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
	timeoutMs?: number;
}
/** Transport only. The original createRegistration still owns submit/unknown/verify state. */
export function createRegisterAdapter(account: AccountHost, options: () => RegisterAdapterOptions) {
	const active = new Set<AbortController>(),
		canVerify = shallowRef(false);
	let generation = 0,
		disposed = false;
	let original:
		| {
				id: string;
				verify?: (
					id: string,
					request: AccountRequest
				) => Promise<Verification<RegistrationField>>;
		  }
		| undefined;
	function cancel() {
		generation++;
		for (const controller of active) controller.abort();
		active.clear();
	}
	const stop = watch(
		() => [
			options().revision,
			options().disabled,
			options().readonly,
			options().mode,
			options().phone,
			options().phone?.register,
			options().phone?.verifyRegistration,
			account.services.register,
			account.services.verifyRegistration
		],
		cancel,
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	async function bounded<T>(
		parent: AccountRequest,
		read: boolean,
		call: (request: AccountRequest) => Promise<T>,
		wipe = () => {}
	) {
		const controller = new AbortController(),
			version = generation;
		active.add(controller);
		const isCurrent = () =>
			!disposed &&
			!controller.signal.aborted &&
			version === generation &&
			parent.isCurrent() &&
			!options().disabled &&
			(read || !options().readonly);
		const request: AccountRequest = {
			operationId: parent.operationId,
			signal: controller.signal,
			isCurrent
		};
		const abort = () => controller.abort();
		parent.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		if (parent.signal.aborted) abort();
		let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined, onAbort: (() => void) | undefined;
		try {
			if (!isCurrent()) throw Error('Registration unavailable');
			const interrupted = new Promise<never>((_resolve, reject) => {
				onAbort = () => {
					wipe();
					reject(Error('Registration interrupted'));
				};
				controller.signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
				if (controller.signal.aborted) onAbort();
				const ms = options().timeoutMs ?? 10000;
				timer = setTimeout(
					abort,
					Number.isFinite(ms) ? Math.min(30000, Math.max(50, ms)) : 10000
				);
			});
			const result = await Promise.race([call(request), interrupted]);
			if (!isCurrent()) throw Error('Stale registration');
			return result;
		} finally {
			wipe();
			clearTimeout(timer);
			parent.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			if (onAbort) controller.signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
			active.delete(controller);
			controller.abort();
		}
	}
	const host: AccountHost = {
		...account,
		services: {
			...account.services,
			async register(input, parent) {
				const o = options(),
					phone = o.mode === 'phone' ? o.phone : undefined;
				if (o.mode === 'phone' && (!phone || phone.owner !== account.security))
					return { status: 'failure', message: 'Registration capability unavailable' };
				const verify = phone
					? phone.verifyRegistration
					: account.services.verifyRegistration;
				original = { id: parent.operationId, verify };
				canVerify.value = !!verify;
				if (phone) {
					const payload = { ...input, ...o.credentials() };
					return bounded(
						parent,
						false,
						(request) => phone.register(payload, request),
						() => {
							payload.password = '';
							payload.code = '';
						}
					);
				}
				const service = account.services.register,
					payload = { ...input };
				return bounded(
					parent,
					false,
					(request) => service(payload, request),
					() => {
						payload.password = '';
					}
				);
			},
			async verifyRegistration(id, parent) {
				if (!original || original.id !== id || !original.verify)
					return { status: 'unknown' };
				const verify = original.verify;
				return bounded(parent, true, (request) => verify(id, request));
			}
		}
	};
	function dispose() {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		cancel();
		stop();
		original = undefined;
		canVerify.value = false;
	}
	onScopeDispose(dispose);
	return { host, canVerify, cancel, dispose };
}

			<main v-else class="register-demo-destination">

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');

import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamConfigProvider,
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './Models.js';
import RegisterWorkspace from './RegisterWorkspace.vue';
import { useRegisterText } from './I18n.js';
import type { createRegisterFixture } from './Fixture.js';
const props = defineProps<{
	fixture: ReturnType<typeof createRegisterFixture>;
	externalI18n?: AsamI18n;
	inheritAppearance?: boolean;
	diagnostics?: boolean;
	onLocale?: (locale: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => void;
}>();
const { i18n, t } = useRegisterText(),
	theme = shallowRef<'light' | 'dark'>('light'),
	size = shallowRef<AsamFlowSize>('large'),
	login = shallowRef(false);
const sizes = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'] as const,
	sendModes = ['success', 'failure', 'unknown'] as const,
	registerModes = [
		'success',
		'failure',
		'field-error',
		'unknown',
		'notWritten',
		'slow',
		'late',
		'never'
	] as const;
function setLocale(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'zh-CN' || value === 'en') props.onLocale?.(value);
}
function setTheme(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark') theme.value = value;
}
function setSize(value: unknown) {
	if (sizes.some((size) => size === value)) size.value = value as AsamFlowSize;
}
function setSend(value: unknown) {
	if (sendModes.some((mode) => mode === value))
		props.fixture.setSend(value as (typeof sendModes)[number]);
}
function setRegister(value: unknown) {
	if (registerModes.some((mode) => mode === value))
		props.fixture.setRegister(value as (typeof registerModes)[number]);
}
function navigate() {
	props.fixture.markNavigated();
	login.value = true;
}
onBeforeUnmount(props.fixture.dispose);
</script>

import { reactive, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AccountRequest, Registration, RegistrationField, WriteResult } from '../Types.js';
import type { RegistrationReceipt } from '../registration-result/Types.js';
import type { PhoneSendVerification } from '../login/Types.js';
import type { AccountPhoneRegistration, RegistrationOutcome } from './Types.js';
import { createAccountFixture } from '../examples/Fixture.js';
/** Synthetic in-memory host only; original account fixture owns mutation/verification records. */
export function createRegisterFixture(i18n: AsamI18n) {
	const account = createAccountFixture(i18n),
		host = { ...account.host, services: { ...account.host.services } };
	const currentHost = shallowRef(host);
	const controls = reactive({
		send: 'success' as 'success' | 'failure' | 'unknown',
		register: 'success' as
			| 'success'
			| 'failure'
			| 'field-error'
			| 'unknown'
			| 'notWritten'
			| 'slow'
			| 'late'
			| 'never',
		readonly: false,
		disabled: false,
		revision: 0,
		delayMs: 100,
		timeoutMs: 1000
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		sends: 0,
		sendVerifies: 0,
		accountSubmissions: 0,
		phoneSubmissions: 0,
		registrationVerifies: 0,
		resends: 0,
		completed: 0,
		navigations: 0,
		disposed: false
	});
	const sends = new Map<string, PhoneSendVerification>(),
		sentPhones = new Set<string>(),
		receipts = new Map<string, RegistrationReceipt>();
	const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
	const text = (zh: string, en: string) => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh);
	async function register(
		input: Readonly<Registration>,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<WriteResult<RegistrationField>> {
		const mode = controls.register,
			email = input.email;
		if (mode === 'never') return new Promise(() => {});
		if (mode === 'notWritten') return { status: 'unknown' };
		if (mode === 'slow') await wait(2000);
		else await wait(controls.delayMs);
		if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
		account.controls.mode = mode === 'late' || mode === 'slow' ? 'success' : mode;
		const result = await account.host.services.register(input, request);
		if (request.isCurrent() && (result.status === 'success' || mode === 'unknown'))
			receipts.set(request.operationId, {
				id: request.operationId,
				email,
				status: 'created'
			});
		if (mode === 'late') await wait(2000);
		return result;
	}
	host.services.register = (input, request) => {
		audit.accountSubmissions++;
		return register(input, request);
	};
	const verifyRegistration = async (id: string, request: AccountRequest) => {
		audit.registrationVerifies++;
		return account.host.services.verifyRegistration!(id, request);
	};
	host.services.verifyRegistration = verifyRegistration;
	const phone: AccountPhoneRegistration = {
		owner: host.security,
		async send(number, request) {
			audit.sends++;
			const mode = controls.send;
			await wait(controls.delayMs);
			if (!request.isCurrent()) {
				sends.set(request.operationId, { status: 'not-sent' });
				return { status: 'unknown' };
			}
			if (mode === 'failure') return { status: 'failure' };
			sentPhones.add(number);
			sends.set(request.operationId, { status: 'sent', retryAfterSeconds: 3 });
			return mode === 'unknown'
				? { status: 'unknown' }
				: { status: 'sent', retryAfterSeconds: 3 };
		},
		async verifySend(id, request) {
			audit.sendVerifies++;
			await wait(controls.delayMs);
			return request.isCurrent()
				? (sends.get(id) ?? { status: 'unknown' })
				: { status: 'unknown' };
		},
		async register(input, request) {
			audit.phoneSubmissions++;
			if (!sentPhones.has(input.phone) || input.code !== '123456')
				return {
					status: 'failure',
					message: text(
						'合成验证码不正确，请重新填写。',
						'The synthetic code is incorrect. Enter it again.'
					)
				};
			return register(input, request);
		},
		verifyRegistration
	};
	const outcome: RegistrationOutcome = {
		owner: host.security,
		receiptFor: (id) => receipts.get(id),
		async resend(_receipt, request) {
			audit.resends++;
			await wait(controls.delayMs);
			if (!request.isCurrent()) throw Error('Cancelled demo email');
			return 'sent';
		}
	};
	return {
		setSend(value: typeof controls.send) {
			controls.send = value;
		},
		setRegister(value: typeof controls.register) {
			controls.register = value;
		},
		toggleReadonly() {
			controls.readonly = !controls.readonly;
		},
		toggleDisabled() {
			controls.disabled = !controls.disabled;
		},
		markCompleted() {
			audit.completed++;
		},
		markNavigated() {
			audit.navigations++;
		},
		get host() {
			return currentHost.value;
		},
		replaceHost() {
			currentHost.value = { ...currentHost.value };
		},
		phone,
		outcome,
		controls,
		audit,
		account,
		invalidate() {
			account.security.expire();
		},
		replaceService() {
			controls.revision++;
		},
		dispose() {
			if (audit.disposed) return;
			audit.disposed = true;
			sends.clear();
			sentPhones.clear();
			receipts.clear();
			account.dispose();
		}
	};
}

<!-- 模板排版沿用仓库Prettier；仅关闭与其冲突的排版规则。 -->

			:resend="outcome.resend"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:readonly="readonly"
			@navigate="navigateResult"
		/><template v-else
			><RegisterForm
				:key="instance"
				:host="host"
				:phone="phone"
				:revision="revision"
				:disabled="disabled"
				:readonly="readonly"
				:size="size"
				:timeout-ms="timeoutMs"
				@completed="complete"
				@login="emit('navigate', 'login')"
			/>
			<p v-if="receiptError" class="register-receipt-error" role="alert">
				{{ t('resultUnavailable') }}
			</p></template
		>
	</div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AccountHost } from '../Types.js';
import type { RegistrationReceipt } from '../registration-result/Types.js';
import type { AccountPhoneRegistration, RegistrationOutcome } from './Types.js';
import RegistrationResult from '../registration-result/RegistrationResult.vue';
import RegisterForm from './RegisterForm.vue';
import { useRegisterText } from './I18n.js';
const props = defineProps<{
	host: AccountHost;
	phone?: AccountPhoneRegistration;
	outcome?: RegistrationOutcome;
	revision?: string | number;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
	timeoutMs?: number;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ completed: [operationId: string]; navigate: [destination: 'login'] }>();
const { t } = useRegisterText();
const receipt = shallowRef<RegistrationReceipt>(),
	receiptError = shallowRef(false),
	instance = shallowRef(0);
let remove = () => {};
function clear() {
	receipt.value = undefined;
	receiptError.value = false;
	instance.value++;
}
watch(
	() => props.host,
	(host) => {
		remove();
		clear();
		remove = host.security.onInvalidate(clear);
	},
	{ immediate: true, flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => [props.outcome, props.revision],
	() => {
		if (receipt.value) clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);

	if (props.disabled) return;
	emit('completed', operationId);
	if (!props.outcome || props.outcome.owner !== props.host.security) return;
	try {
		const value = props.outcome.receiptFor(operationId);
		if (
			!value ||
			value.id !== operationId ||
			!value.email ||
			!['created', 'expired', 'verified'].includes(value.status)

			receiptError.value = true;
			return;
		}
		receipt.value = Object.freeze({ id: value.id, email: value.email, status: value.status });
	} catch {
		receiptError.value = true;
	}
}

	if (props.disabled) return;
	if (destination === 'register') clear();
	else emit('navigate', 'login');
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => remove());
</script>

/** Presentation guidance only; createRegistration/host owns acceptance policy. */
export function passwordStrength(value: string, minimum: number) {
	if (!value) return 'empty' as const;
	if (value.length < minimum) return 'weak' as const;
	const kinds = [/[a-z]/, /[A-Z]/, /\d/, /[^a-zA-Z\d]/].filter((rule) => rule.test(value)).length;
	return kinds >= 3 ? ('strong' as const) : ('medium' as const);
}

import type {

	Registration,
	RegistrationField,
	Verification,
	WriteResult
} from '../Types.js';
import type { AccountPhoneLogin } from '../login/Types.js';
import type { RegistrationReceipt, RegistrationResultProps } from '../registration-result/Types.js';
/** Explicit registration capability; phone/code remain separate from the real new password. */
export interface AccountPhoneRegistration extends Pick<
	AccountPhoneLogin,
	'owner' | 'send' | 'verifySend'
> {

		input: Readonly<Registration & { phone: string; code: string }>,
		request: AccountRequest
	) => Promise<WriteResult<RegistrationField>>;
	readonly verifyRegistration?: (
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	) => Promise<Verification<RegistrationField>>;
}
/** Only return the public receipt of this confirmed original mutation; no passwords or codes. */
export interface RegistrationOutcome {
	readonly owner: AccountHost['security'];
	readonly receiptFor: (operationId: string) => RegistrationReceipt | undefined;
	readonly resend: RegistrationResultProps['resend'];
}

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
import { createRegisterFixture } from './Fixture.js';
export function mountWorkspaceRegister(
	element: Element,
	host?: { i18n?: AsamI18n; inheritAppearance?: boolean; diagnostics?: boolean },
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void
) {
	const locale = shallowRef<'zh-CN' | 'en'>('zh-CN'),
		i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value })),
		fixture = createRegisterFixture(i18n);
	const app = createApp(App, {
		fixture,
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		diagnostics: host?.diagnostics,
		onLocale: (value: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'workspace-register-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

<template>
	<section class="registration-result" :aria-label="t('title')">
		<AsamCard bordered shadow="never" :body-style="{ padding: '0' }"
			><AsamResult
				:icon="expired ? 'warning' : 'success'"
				:title="t(verified ? 'verified' : expired ? 'expired' : 'title')"
				:sub-title="
					t(
						verified
							? 'verifiedDescription'
							: expired
								? 'expiredDescription'
								: 'description'
					)
				"
			/>
			<div class="registration-result-content">
				<div class="registration-receipt">
					<AsamDescriptions :column="1" direction="vertical"
						><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="t('email')"
							><bdi class="registration-email">{{
								displayEmail
							}}</bdi></AsamDescriptionsItem
						><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="t('next')">{{
							t(verified ? 'verifiedDescription' : 'instructions')
						}}</AsamDescriptionsItem></AsamDescriptions
					>
				</div>
				<p class="registration-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite">
					{{ feedback ? t(feedback) : '' }}
				</p>
				<div class="registration-actions">
					<AsamButton
						v-if="verified && workspace"
						type="primary"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="emit('workspace')"
						>{{ t('workspace') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						v-else
						type="primary"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="emit('navigate', 'login')"
						>{{ t('login') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						v-if="!verified"
						type="primary"
						plain
						:loading="pending"
						:disabled="disabled || readonly || pending || remaining > 0"
						@click="send"
						>{{
							pending
								? t('sending')
								: remaining
									? `${remaining} ${t('cooldown')}`
									: t('resend')
						}}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						v-if="expired"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="emit('navigate', 'register')"
						type="primary"
						>{{ t('register') }}</AsamButton
					>
				</div>
			</div></AsamCard
		>
	</section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamCard,
	AsamDescriptions,
	AsamDescriptionsItem,
	AsamResult
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { RegistrationResultEmits, RegistrationResultProps } from './Types.js';
import { registrationResultText, useRegistrationResultI18n } from './I18n.js';
import type { RegistrationResultLabel } from './I18n.js';

const props = defineProps<RegistrationResultProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<RegistrationResultEmits>();
const i18n = useRegistrationResultI18n();
const t = (key: RegistrationResultLabel) => registrationResultText(i18n, key);
const expired = shallowRef(props.receipt.status === 'expired');
const verified = computed(() => props.receipt.status === 'verified');
const displayEmail = computed(() => {
	const email = props.receipt.email;
	const separator = email.lastIndexOf('@');
	const account = email.slice(0, separator);
	if (separator <= 0 || separator === email.length - 1) return '—';
	if (account.endsWith('***')) return email;
	return `${account.slice(0, Math.min(2, account.length - 1))}***${email.slice(separator)}`;
});
const pending = shallowRef(false);
const remaining = shallowRef(0);
const feedback = shallowRef<'sent' | 'failure' | 'expired'>();
let controller: AbortController | undefined;
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
let active = true;

function invalidate() {
	controller?.abort();
	controller = undefined;
	clearInterval(timer);
	timer = undefined;
	pending.value = false;
	remaining.value = 0;
	feedback.value = undefined;
}
watch(
	() => [props.receipt.id, props.receipt.email, props.receipt.status],
	() => {
		invalidate();
		expired.value = props.receipt.status === 'expired';
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => [props.disabled, props.readonly],
	() => {
		if (pending.value) invalidate();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);

async function send() {
	if (
		!active ||
		verified.value ||
		props.disabled ||
		props.readonly ||
		pending.value ||
		remaining.value
	)
		return;
	const own = new AbortController();
	controller = own;
	const receipt = Object.freeze({ ...props.receipt });
	const isCurrent = () =>
		active &&
		controller === own &&
		!own.signal.aborted &&
		props.receipt.id === receipt.id &&
		props.receipt.email === receipt.email &&
		props.receipt.status === receipt.status &&
		!props.disabled &&
		!props.readonly;
	pending.value = true;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	try {
		const result = await props.resend(receipt, { signal: own.signal, isCurrent });
		if (!isCurrent()) return;
		expired.value = result === 'expired';
		feedback.value = result === 'expired' ? 'expired' : 'sent';
		if (result !== 'expired') {
			const retryAfter = result === 'sent' ? 60 : result.retryAfter;
			if (!Number.isSafeInteger(retryAfter * 1000) || retryAfter <= 0) return;
			const until = Date.now() + retryAfter * 1000;
			remaining.value = Math.ceil(retryAfter);
			timer = setInterval(() => {
				remaining.value = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((until - Date.now()) / 1000));
				if (!remaining.value) {
					clearInterval(timer);
					timer = undefined;
				}
			}, 250);
		}
	} catch {
		if (isCurrent()) feedback.value = 'failure';
	} finally {
		if (controller === own) {
			controller = undefined;
			pending.value = false;
		}
	}
}
onScopeDispose(() => {
	active = false;
	invalidate();
});
</script>

/** 已确认的注册回执，不接收密码或其它注册请求内容。 */
export interface RegistrationReceipt {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly email: string;
	readonly status: 'created' | 'expired' | 'verified';
}

export interface VerificationMailRequest {
	readonly signal: AbortSignal;
	/** 宿主提交发送副作用前也须核对本请求是否仍属于当前回执。 */
	readonly isCurrent: () => boolean;
}

export interface RegistrationResultProps {
	receipt: RegistrationReceipt;
	resend: (
		receipt: RegistrationReceipt,
		request: VerificationMailRequest
	) => Promise<'sent' | 'expired' | { readonly status: 'sent'; readonly retryAfter: number }>;
	workspace?: boolean;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
}

export interface RegistrationResultEmits {
	navigate: [destination: 'login' | 'register'];
	workspace: [];
}

		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		language: text(value.language),

		digest: value.digest === true,

export function createRegistration(host, i18n) {
	const display = feedback(i18n);

		email: '',
		password: '',
		confirm: '',
		consent: false
	});
	const status = ref('idle');
	const operationId = ref('');
	const secretClear = () => {
		draft.password = '';
		draft.confirm = '';
	};

		Object.assign(draft, { account: '', email: '', password: '', confirm: '', consent: false });

		operationId.value = '';

	function accept(result) {

		errors.value = result.status === 'field-error' ? result.fields : {};
		sources.value = {};

		else if (result.status === 'unknown')

		else

		} catch {

			return false;
		}

			status.value = 'field-error';
			return false;
		}

			account: draft.account,
			email: draft.email,
			password: draft.password,
			consent: draft.consent

		draft,
		status,
		errors,
		message,

		displayErrors: display.displayErrors,

					mode: 'data',

						mode === 'empty'

									email: settings.email,
									phone: settings.phone,
									organization: `演示组织 ${String(person.scope.organization)}`,
									role: '应用成员',

						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示保存被拒绝，请修改后重试' }

</template>
<script setup>
import { AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamConfigProvider,
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import RegisterWorkspace from './RegisterWorkspace.vue';
import { useRegisterText } from './I18n.js';
const props = defineProps({
	fixture: { type: null, required: true },
	externalI18n: { type: Object, required: false },
	inheritAppearance: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	diagnostics: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	onLocale: { type: Function, required: false }
});
const { i18n, t } = useRegisterText(),
	theme = shallowRef('light'),
	size = shallowRef('large'),
	login = shallowRef(false);
const sizes = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'],
	sendModes = ['success', 'failure', 'unknown'],
	registerModes = [
		'success',
		'failure',
		'field-error',
		'unknown',
		'notWritten',
		'slow',
		'late',
		'never'
	];
function setLocale(value) {
	if (value === 'zh-CN' || value === 'en') props.onLocale?.(value);
}
function setTheme(value) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark') theme.value = value;
}
function setSize(value) {
	if (sizes.some((size) => size === value)) size.value = value;
}
function setSend(value) {
	if (sendModes.some((mode) => mode === value)) props.fixture.setSend(value);
}
function setRegister(value) {
	if (registerModes.some((mode) => mode === value)) props.fixture.setRegister(value);
}
function navigate() {
	props.fixture.markNavigated();
	login.value = true;
}
onBeforeUnmount(props.fixture.dispose);
</script>

import { reactive, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { createAccountFixture } from '../examples/Fixture.js';
/** Synthetic in-memory host only; original account fixture owns mutation/verification records. */
export function createRegisterFixture(i18n) {
	const account = createAccountFixture(i18n),
		host = { ...account.host, services: { ...account.host.services } };
	const currentHost = shallowRef(host);
	const controls = reactive({
		send: 'success',
		register: 'success',
		readonly: false,
		disabled: false,
		revision: 0,
		delayMs: 100,
		timeoutMs: 1000
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		sends: 0,
		sendVerifies: 0,
		accountSubmissions: 0,
		phoneSubmissions: 0,
		registrationVerifies: 0,
		resends: 0,
		completed: 0,
		navigations: 0,
		disposed: false
	});
	const sends = new Map(),
		sentPhones = new Set(),
		receipts = new Map();
	const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
	const text = (zh, en) => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh);
	async function register(input, request) {
		const mode = controls.register,
			email = input.email;
		if (mode === 'never') return new Promise(() => {});
		if (mode === 'notWritten') return { status: 'unknown' };
		if (mode === 'slow') await wait(2000);
		else await wait(controls.delayMs);
		if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
		account.controls.mode = mode === 'late' || mode === 'slow' ? 'success' : mode;
		const result = await account.host.services.register(input, request);
		if (request.isCurrent() && (result.status === 'success' || mode === 'unknown'))
			receipts.set(request.operationId, {
				id: request.operationId,
				email,
				status: 'created'
			});
		if (mode === 'late') await wait(2000);
		return result;
	}
	host.services.register = (input, request) => {
		audit.accountSubmissions++;
		return register(input, request);
	};
	const verifyRegistration = async (id, request) => {
		audit.registrationVerifies++;
		return account.host.services.verifyRegistration(id, request);
	};
	host.services.verifyRegistration = verifyRegistration;
	const phone = {
		owner: host.security,
		async send(number, request) {
			audit.sends++;
			const mode = controls.send;
			await wait(controls.delayMs);
			if (!request.isCurrent()) {
				sends.set(request.operationId, { status: 'not-sent' });
				return { status: 'unknown' };
			}
			if (mode === 'failure') return { status: 'failure' };
			sentPhones.add(number);
			sends.set(request.operationId, { status: 'sent', retryAfterSeconds: 3 });
			return mode === 'unknown'
				? { status: 'unknown' }
				: { status: 'sent', retryAfterSeconds: 3 };
		},
		async verifySend(id, request) {
			audit.sendVerifies++;
			await wait(controls.delayMs);
			return request.isCurrent()
				? (sends.get(id) ?? { status: 'unknown' })
				: { status: 'unknown' };
		},
		async register(input, request) {
			audit.phoneSubmissions++;
			if (!sentPhones.has(input.phone) || input.code !== '123456')
				return {
					status: 'failure',
					message: text(
						'合成验证码不正确，请重新填写。',
						'The synthetic code is incorrect. Enter it again.'
					)
				};
			return register(input, request);
		},
		verifyRegistration
	};
	const outcome = {
		owner: host.security,
		receiptFor: (id) => receipts.get(id),
		async resend(_receipt, request) {
			audit.resends++;
			await wait(controls.delayMs);
			if (!request.isCurrent()) throw Error('Cancelled demo email');
			return 'sent';
		}
	};
	return {
		setSend(value) {
			controls.send = value;
		},
		setRegister(value) {
			controls.register = value;
		},
		toggleReadonly() {
			controls.readonly = !controls.readonly;
		},
		toggleDisabled() {
			controls.disabled = !controls.disabled;
		},
		markCompleted() {
			audit.completed++;
		},
		markNavigated() {
			audit.navigations++;
		},
		get host() {
			return currentHost.value;
		},
		replaceHost() {
			currentHost.value = { ...currentHost.value };
		},
		phone,
		outcome,
		controls,
		audit,
		account,
		invalidate() {
			account.security.expire();
		},
		replaceService() {
			controls.revision++;
		},
		dispose() {
			if (audit.disposed) return;
			audit.disposed = true;
			sends.clear();
			sentPhones.clear();
			receipts.clear();
			account.dispose();
		}
	};
}

<!-- 模板排版沿用仓库Prettier；仅关闭与其冲突的排版规则。 -->
<!-- eslint-disable vue/html-indent, vue/html-closing-bracket-newline, vue/html-self-closing, vue/multiline-html-element-content-newline, vue/max-attributes-per-line -->
<template>
	<section
		class="register-layout"
		:data-account-state="registration.status.value"
		:data-send-state="challenge.status.value"
	>
		<aside class="register-story">
			<strong class="register-brand">A <span>ASAM</span></strong>
			<div>
				<p class="register-eyebrow">ASAM WORKSPACE</p>
				<h2>{{ t('story') }}</h2>
				<p>{{ t('storyIntro') }}</p>
			</div>
			<div class="register-art">
				<div class="register-tags">
					<AsamTag type="primary">{{ t('team') }}</AsamTag
					><AsamTag type="success">{{ t('progress') }}</AsamTag>
				</div>
				<h3>{{ t('artTitle') }}</h3>
				<AsamProgress :percentage="68" :stroke-width="6" /><small>{{ t('artHint') }}</small>
			</div>
			<small>ASAM WORKSPACE</small>
		</aside>
		<div class="register-panel">
			<header>
				<h1>{{ t('title') }}</h1>
				<p>{{ t('intro') }}</p>
			</header>
			<AsamTabs
				v-if="challenge.owned.value"
				:model-value="mode"
				:items="tabs"
				@update:model-value="setMode"
			/><AsamForm
				:model-value="registration.draft"
				:inline="false"
				:show-search="false"
				:show-reset="false"
				label-position="top"
				:size="size"
				v-on="formEvents"
				><AsamFormItem
					:label="host.registration?.accountLabel ?? accountText('username')"
					:error="registration.displayErrors.value.account"
					><AsamInput
						:model-value="registration.draft.account"
						name="username"
						autocomplete="username"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="locked"
						:readonly="readonly"
						@update:model-value="setField('account', $event)" /></AsamFormItem
				><AsamFormItem
					:label="accountText('email')"
					:error="registration.displayErrors.value.email"
					><AsamInput
						:model-value="registration.draft.email"
						name="email"
						autocomplete="email"
						inputmode="email"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="locked"
						:readonly="readonly"
						@update:model-value="setField('email', $event)"
				/></AsamFormItem>
				<div v-if="mode === 'phone'" class="register-phone-fields">
					<AsamFormItem
						:label="t('phone')"
						:error="extraError === 'invalidPhone' ? t('invalidPhone') : undefined"
						><AsamInput
							:model-value="phoneDraft.phone"
							name="phone"
							autocomplete="tel"
							inputmode="tel"
							:size="size"
							:disabled="locked || challenge.busy.value || challenge.uncertain.value"
							:readonly="readonly"
							@update:model-value="setPhone" /></AsamFormItem
					><AsamFormItem
						:label="t('code')"
						:error="
							extraError && extraError !== 'invalidPhone' ? t(extraError) : undefined
						"
						><div class="register-code">
							<AsamInput
								:model-value="phoneDraft.code"
								name="code"
								autocomplete="one-time-code"
								inputmode="numeric"
								:maxlength="6"
								:size="size"
								:disabled="
									locked || challenge.busy.value || challenge.uncertain.value
								"
								:readonly="readonly"
								@update:model-value="phoneDraft.code = String($event ?? '')"
							/><AsamButton
								:size="size"
								plain
								type="primary"
								:disabled="
									locked ||
									readonly ||
									challenge.busy.value ||
									challenge.uncertain.value ||
									challenge.remaining.value > 0 ||
									!validLoginPhone(phoneDraft.phone)
								"
								@click="challenge.send(phoneDraft.phone)"
								>{{
									challenge.busy.value
										? t('sending')
										: challenge.remaining.value
											? challenge.remaining.value + ' ' + t('cooldown')
											: t('send')
								}}</AsamButton
							>
						</div></AsamFormItem
					>
					<p class="register-code-feedback" role="status">
						{{ challenge.feedback.value ? t(challenge.feedback.value) : '' }}
					</p>
					<AsamButton
						v-if="challenge.uncertain.value && phone?.verifySend"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled || challenge.busy.value"
						@click="challenge.verify()"
						type="primary"
						>{{ t('verifySend') }}</AsamButton
					>
				</div>
				<AsamFormItem
					:label="accountText('password')"
					:error="registration.displayErrors.value.password"
					><AsamPassword
						:model-value="registration.draft.password"
						name="new-password"
						autocomplete="new-password"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="locked"
						:readonly="readonly"
						@update:model-value="setField('password', $event)"
				/></AsamFormItem>
				<div class="register-strength" role="status" aria-live="polite">

				:key="instance"
				:host="host"
				:phone="phone"
				:revision="revision"
				:disabled="disabled"
				:readonly="readonly"
				:size="size"
				:timeout-ms="timeoutMs"
				@completed="complete"
				@login="emit('navigate', 'login')"

<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import RegistrationResult from '../registration-result/RegistrationResult.vue';
import RegisterForm from './RegisterForm.vue';
import { useRegisterText } from './I18n.js';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	phone: { type: Object, required: false },
	outcome: { type: Object, required: false },
	revision: { type: [String, Number], required: false },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	timeoutMs: { type: Number, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['completed', 'navigate']);
const { t } = useRegisterText();
const receipt = shallowRef(),
	receiptError = shallowRef(false),
	instance = shallowRef(0);
let remove = () => {};
function clear() {
	receipt.value = undefined;
	receiptError.value = false;
	instance.value++;
}
watch(
	() => props.host,
	(host) => {
		remove();
		clear();
		remove = host.security.onInvalidate(clear);
	},
	{ immediate: true, flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => [props.outcome, props.revision],
	() => {
		if (receipt.value) clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
function complete(operationId) {
	if (props.disabled) return;
	emit('completed', operationId);
	if (!props.outcome || props.outcome.owner !== props.host.security) return;
	try {
		const value = props.outcome.receiptFor(operationId);
		if (
			!value ||
			value.id !== operationId ||
			!value.email ||
			!['created', 'expired', 'verified'].includes(value.status)
		) {
			receiptError.value = true;
			return;
		}
		receipt.value = Object.freeze({ id: value.id, email: value.email, status: value.status });
	} catch {
		receiptError.value = true;
	}
}
function navigateResult(destination) {
	if (props.disabled) return;
	if (destination === 'register') clear();
	else emit('navigate', 'login');
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => remove());
</script>

/** Presentation guidance only; createRegistration/host owns acceptance policy. */
export function passwordStrength(value, minimum) {
	if (!value) return 'empty';
	if (value.length < minimum) return 'weak';
	const kinds = [/[a-z]/, /[A-Z]/, /\d/, /[^a-zA-Z\d]/].filter((rule) => rule.test(value)).length;
	return kinds >= 3 ? 'strong' : 'medium';
}

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
import { createRegisterFixture } from './Fixture.js';
export function mountWorkspaceRegister(element, host, onError) {
	const locale = shallowRef('zh-CN'),
		i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value })),
		fixture = createRegisterFixture(i18n);
	const app = createApp(App, {
		fixture,
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		diagnostics: host?.diagnostics,
		onLocale: (value) => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'workspace-register-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}
