					>
				</div>
				<p class="registration-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite">
					{{ feedback ? t(feedback) : '' }}
				</p>
				<div class="registration-actions">
					<AsamButton
						v-if="verified && workspace"
						type="primary"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="emit('workspace')"
						>{{ t('workspace') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						v-else
						type="primary"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="emit('navigate', 'login')"
						>{{ t('login') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						v-if="!verified"
						type="primary"
						plain
						:loading="pending"
						:disabled="disabled || readonly || pending || remaining > 0"
						@click="send"
						>{{
							pending
								? t('sending')
								: remaining
									? `${remaining} ${t('cooldown')}`
									: t('resend')
						}}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						v-if="expired"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="emit('navigate', 'register')"
						type="primary"
						>{{ t('register') }}</AsamButton
					>
				</div>
			</div></AsamCard
		>
	</section>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamCard,
	AsamDescriptions,
	AsamDescriptionsItem,
	AsamResult
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { registrationResultText, useRegistrationResultI18n } from './I18n.js';
const props = defineProps({
	receipt: { type: Object, required: true },
	resend: { type: Function, required: true },
	workspace: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['navigate', 'workspace']);
const i18n = useRegistrationResultI18n();
const t = (key) => registrationResultText(i18n, key);
const expired = shallowRef(props.receipt.status === 'expired');
const verified = computed(() => props.receipt.status === 'verified');
const displayEmail = computed(() => {
	const email = props.receipt.email;
	const separator = email.lastIndexOf('@');
	const account = email.slice(0, separator);
	if (separator <= 0 || separator === email.length - 1) return '—';
	if (account.endsWith('***')) return email;
	return `${account.slice(0, Math.min(2, account.length - 1))}***${email.slice(separator)}`;
});
const pending = shallowRef(false);
const remaining = shallowRef(0);
const feedback = shallowRef();
let controller;
let timer;
let active = true;
function invalidate() {
	controller?.abort();
	controller = undefined;
	clearInterval(timer);
	timer = undefined;
	pending.value = false;
	remaining.value = 0;
	feedback.value = undefined;
}
watch(
	() => [props.receipt.id, props.receipt.email, props.receipt.status],
	() => {
		invalidate();
		expired.value = props.receipt.status === 'expired';
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => [props.disabled, props.readonly],
	() => {
		if (pending.value) invalidate();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
async function send() {
	if (
		!active ||
		verified.value ||
		props.disabled ||
		props.readonly ||
		pending.value ||
		remaining.value
	)
		return;
	const own = new AbortController();
	controller = own;
	const receipt = Object.freeze({ ...props.receipt });
	const isCurrent = () =>
		active &&
		controller === own &&
		!own.signal.aborted &&
		props.receipt.id === receipt.id &&
		props.receipt.email === receipt.email &&
		props.receipt.status === receipt.status &&
		!props.disabled &&
		!props.readonly;
	pending.value = true;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	try {
		const result = await props.resend(receipt, { signal: own.signal, isCurrent });
		if (!isCurrent()) return;
		expired.value = result === 'expired';
		feedback.value = result === 'expired' ? 'expired' : 'sent';
		if (result !== 'expired') {
			const retryAfter = result === 'sent' ? 60 : result.retryAfter;
			if (!Number.isSafeInteger(retryAfter * 1000) || retryAfter <= 0) return;
			const until = Date.now() + retryAfter * 1000;
			remaining.value = Math.ceil(retryAfter);
			timer = setInterval(() => {
				remaining.value = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((until - Date.now()) / 1000));
				if (!remaining.value) {
					clearInterval(timer);
					timer = undefined;
				}
			}, 250);
		}
	} catch {
		if (isCurrent()) feedback.value = 'failure';
	} finally {
		if (controller === own) {
			controller = undefined;
			pending.value = false;
		}
	}
}
onScopeDispose(() => {
	active = false;
	invalidate();
});
</script>

}

	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

	min-height: 1.75em;

}
.registration-actions {

}
@container (max-width: 520px) {

	}
}
</style>

export {};

注册工作区包含品牌介绍、账号与可选手机验证码注册、密码强度提示、条款及已确认注册回执。实际使用ASAM基础控件，复用原账户注册与unknown核实协调。

交互与边界

最短密码、用户名、邮箱、确认与条款保持原宿主规则；强度仅提示。发送失败可手动重试，发送unknown先核实原操作；冷却由明确宿主响应确定。手机注册保留独立phone/code和真实新密码，不把验证码塞入密码。

注册取消/超时保持unknown并核实原operationId，不自动重发。确认成功才使用宿主的公开回执组合原注册结果页；未配置回执时保留成功反馈与导航意图。验证码123456、3秒冷却仅为内存演示，不发送真实短信或邮件，不创建真实账户。

接入与生命周期

复制RegisterWorkspace和配套文件，传入原AccountHost以及可选AccountPhoneRegistration/RegistrationOutcome。owner必须绑定当前security；服务变更更新revision，host替换会释放旧表单。signal/isCurrent必须在宿主副作用前再次核验，密码和code不进入回执、日志或审计。正常包与锁/补丁保留，TS/JS源码、复制和ZIP/运行同源；无iframe或源码alias。

本页内容
注册工作区页交互与边界接入与生命周期
